mapper.select: SELECT parameter_key, numeric_value, text_value, revision FROM ebay_replenishment_v2_parameter ORDER BY parameter_key FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ebay_replenishment_v2_parameter SET numeric_value=#{row.numericValue}, text_value=#{row.textValue}, revision=revision+1, update_by=#{operator}, update_time=NOW() WHERE parameter_key=#{row.parameterKey} AND revision=#{row.revision}
